title: Medical and Life-Support Protections — Postponement Lengths, Limits and Collections Terms
content:
For customers holding Medical and Life-Support Protections, the length of a disconnection postponement, how many may follow the first within any 12 months, the most postponement days in any rolling 12 months and the start of a postponement are set per protection.

## Postponement figures

| Protection | Calendar days a postponement lasts | Postponements that may follow the first within any 12 months | Most postponement days in any rolling 12 months | When a postponement starts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Emergency Certificate | 21 | 2 | 63 | starts on the date the certificate is registered |
| Standard Medical Baseline Allowance | 30 | 2 | 90 | starts on the date the postponement is requested |
| Heating and Cooling Medical Baseline Allowance | 30 | 2 | 90 | starts on the date the postponement is requested |
| Combined Medical Baseline Allowance | 30 | 2 | 90 | starts on the date the postponement is requested |
| Life-Support Registration | 60 | 2 | 180 | starts on the date the postponement is requested |
| Critical Care Life-Support Registration | 60 | 2 | 180 | starts on the date the postponement is requested |

## Collections terms that accompany the protection

| Protection | A disconnection after a postponement requires a new written notice | A payment arrangement is offered when a postponement is granted | The payment arrangement program's medical cure extension applies while the certification is active |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Emergency Certificate | yes | yes | yes |
| Standard Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | yes | yes |
| Heating and Cooling Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | yes | yes |
| Combined Medical Baseline Allowance | yes | yes | yes |
| Life-Support Registration | yes | yes | yes |
| Critical Care Life-Support Registration | yes | yes | yes |

## Notes

- Two postponements may follow the first under every protection, so the count within any 12 months reaches at most three; the day limit differs by protection (63, 90 or 180 days).
- Only the Medical Emergency Certificate starts a postponement on the date the certificate is registered; under the other five protections a postponement starts on the date it is requested.
- The three collections terms read yes for all six protections.

### Hypothetical illustration

Under the Life-Support Registration a postponement lasts 60 calendar days. A first postponement requested on 1 March runs 1 March through 29 April, the 60 days being counted with both the first and the last day included.
